integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic sci-fi realism with anamorphic lens character, deep navy and amber palette with cyan crystal accents, volumetric god rays, practical lens flares, wet-lens highlights, IMAX-grade detail and subtle film grain. A vertical low-angle composition holds the initial frame as the fleet of small silhouette ships climbs in a column toward the huge amber-lit wormhole aperture high in the frame, the purple crystal planet and its single pulsing beacon sitting low on the left, cyan crystal accents running along the planet's limb. One after another the ships vanish into thin wormhole slits; the camera pulls out at slow speed and the last ship stretches into an amber streak and disappears. The pull-back continues until the crystal planet and its lone pulsing beacon fill the lower frame, the starfield settling to silence, ending on the beacon's steady glow.

overall_soundscape: A deep resonant hum from the wormhole aperture carries a thin engine whine that thins out one ship at a time, each jump leaving a brief subsonic thump. Beneath it, a faint crystalline ring from the planet's beacon pulses evenly. As the camera pulls back, the hum and whine decay until the last seconds hold near-total silence under the beacon's steady tone.

non_diegetic_music: A sparse low synth drone in a slow, even pulse that thins layer by layer and fades out completely before the shot ends, leaving the final moment unscored.
